about: S3.5 defined terms and cross-references (DOC-04) — the HELD-OUT set (fourth, Phase 3 gate): written for definitions-s3.5c before it was run, never used to change it, run once per version. Fictional documents only. Earlier held-out sets are G5–G10 in golden.json.

documents.name: dpa.txt
documents.text:
DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between Lumen Clinics Ltd (the "Controller") and Corelogic Hosting Ltd (the "Processor").

1. Definitions
1.1 "Personal Data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable person.
1.2 "Supervisory Authority" means the data protection regulator.
1.3 "Breach" means a personal data breach.

2. Processing
2.1 The Processor shall process Personal Data only on the Controller's instructions.
2.2 The Processor shall not disclose personal data to any third party.
2.3 The Processor may appoint a Sub-processor only with the Controller's consent, and each Sub-processor shall be bound by clause 6 (Audits).

6. Security
6.1 The Processor shall notify the Controller of any Breach without undue delay.

7. Audits
7.1 The Controller may audit the Processor once a year.

9. Term
9.1 This Agreement ends when the services end, subject to clause 14.

SHAREHOLDERS' AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between the shareholders listed in the Schedule (each a "Shareholder") and Pike Robotics Ltd (the "Company").

1. Board
1.1 Each Shareholder may appoint one director of the Company.

4. Consents
4.1 The Company shall not do any of the following without Investor Consent:
(a) issue shares;
(b) incur debt;
(d) change its business.
4.2 Investor Consent may be given in writing.
4.2 The Shareholders shall vote to give effect to this Agreement.

Schedule Shareholders
The shareholders and their holdings (fictional).

CONSULTANCY AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between Fenwick Advisory Ltd (the "Consultant") and Orrin Logistics plc (the "Client").

1. Definitions
1.1 "Services" means the review described in clause 2.
1.2 "Fee" means GBP 900 per day (fictional).

2. Services
2.1 The Consultant shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care.
2.2 The Client shall pay the Fee monthly.

3. Term
3.1 Clause 2 continues until the Services are complete.
